$comment: Released <agent-3d> CDN versions and the exact bytes each one is. Written only by `npm run release:lib`; scripts/publish-lib.mjs serves every version listed here from the archive (verified against these hashes) under its immutable /agent-3d/<version>/ path, and scripts/check-dist.mjs fails a build whose dist or documented SRI pins disagree with it. See docs/web-component.md#cdn-versioning.
